notes: This reviewed entry is an acceptance candidate only. It does not prove account access, pricing, paid generation, artifact storage, provider-cost reconciliation or production route readiness.
The exact stable Gemini Developer API model ID is gemini-omni-1.1-flash. It uses POST /v1beta/interactions; it is not a Veo predictLongRunning alias.

The provider supports text, image and video input, conversational editing with previous_interaction_id, reference generation and tail-only extension. The frozen public generation contract cannot bind an interaction lineage or distinguish edit from extend, so only stateless text-to-video and image-to-video are published here.

The effective implementation ceiling accepts at most two images and one output, 3 through 10 seconds, 16:9 or 9:16, and 360p, 720p, 1080p or 4k. One image is ordinary image-to-video; two images can express the documented first/last-frame or subject-reference case through the Interactions input. The 2000-character prompt limit is a conservative product admission limit, not a claim of the provider maximum.

Omni generates a video with audio and returns MP4 content. Audio references are not accepted by the current API. All generated videos include SynthID; artifact verification and durable storage are still required before terminal success.

Uploaded videos for edit or extension are limited to ten seconds and extension appends only at the end. Those semantics require a versioned interaction/task contract and are blocked rather than being mislabeled as generic video_to_video.
This is the exact Gemini Developer API preview ID, not the Vertex GA -001 ID. It remains route-acceptance-required and is not production evidence.

The existing converter preserves one prompt, at most one initial image, duration, aspect ratio, resolution, sampleCount=1 and one MP4 result. It does not preserve lastFrame, referenceImages or a prior Veo video, so interpolation, reference generation and extension remain blocked.

The provider allows 4, 6 or 8 seconds, but 1080p and 4k require eight seconds. Since capability v1 cannot express a duration-resolution dependency, the executable subset publishes eight seconds with 720p, 1080p and 4k so every advertised combination is valid.

The provider prompt ceiling is 1024 tokens while the public schema counts characters. The 512-character limit is a conservative UI guard and does not replace provider-token admission at submission time.
Gemini API Veo 3.1 always generates audio with the video. The current public capability has no audio-output toggle and therefore must not display one.
This is the exact Gemini Developer API Fast preview ID, not the Vertex GA -001 ID. It remains route-acceptance-required and is not production evidence.

The existing converter preserves only stateless text-to-video and one-initial-image image-to-video. First/last-frame interpolation, reference images and Veo-video extension are blocked until their distinct request fields and artifact lineage are preserved.

The safe public rectangle is one eight-second MP4 at 720p, 1080p or 4k in 16:9 or 9:16. The model's shorter durations are intentionally withheld because capability v1 cannot couple them to the resolution constraint.
The 512-character prompt guard does not replace the provider's 1024-token limit. Gemini API Veo audio is always on and is not exposed as a user-selectable option.
